author: wmzy <https://github.com/wmzy>
docs:
Theme classes for haze-ui: `lightTheme`/`darkTheme` plus `spacing` and `typography`, applied to a root element to activate the `--haze-*` design tokens. Exports: `lightTheme`, `darkTheme`, `violetTheme`, `tealTheme`, `cyanTheme`, `orangeTheme`, `roseTheme`, `spacing`, `compact`, `typography`. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add wmzy/haze-ui/tokens ``` The wrapper lands at `lib/haze/tokens.tsx` (via the `@lib/` target placeholder from `components.json`); the `haze-ui` npm package is installed automatically as a dependency. ## Theming This wrapper re-exports the 'lightTheme' (or 'darkTheme'), 'spacing' and 'typography' classes from 'haze-ui' and imports 'haze-ui/css/tokens.css'. Activate the design tokens by applying the classes to a root element: ```jsx import { lightTheme, spacing, typography } from 'haze-ui'; // on or any root container — darkTheme is a drop-in swap
…
``` Details: https://github.com/wmzy/haze-ui/tree/main/registry
